title: feat(nm2cycfrmsl): cyclic-frame transport of (m,o_next,o_prev) at t+1 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Defines the oriented frame F=(m,o_next,o_prev) from the 1-in 2-out split of M and its outgoing dual O at t+1 and scores transport as a signed permutation sending F(q) to a formed six-neighbour's frame with determinant Orient(q)*Orient(r); on the two-axis same-lock z-probes split fails at A while transport HOLDs at B, C and D, so reverse fails and face HOLDs.
